title: Protein and Amino Acid Requirements in Human Nutrition
authors: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
text: The World Health Organization establishes the safe level of protein intake for healthy adults at 0.83 grams per kilogram of body weight per day. This value is determined to meet the protein needs of 97.5% of the healthy adult population, assuming a diet with mixed protein sources. This is a baseline requirement for maintaining nitrogen balance and preventing deficiency in non-exercising populations, rather than an optimal target for athletes or those undergoing heavy resistance training.
